verdict.rationale: Poke's docs say it supports MCP servers as a way to extend it with custom tools and data sources. Users can add any MCP-compatible server directly with `npx poke@latest mcp add <url>`, and can tunnel a local dev server with `npx poke@latest tunnel`. Poke also sends an X-Poke-User-Id header on every request to the server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that plugged-in MCP tools work reliably in practice, and documentation on supported transports and auth for added servers.
